title: Grandad's fire ring has three seats, and the empty one never stays empty for long.
description:
Every autumn I camped on the moor with Grandad, by the same old stone fire ring with three seats round it. This year his knees can't do the climb, so Dad comes instead. Dad has never camped in his life, and somehow he gets everything right.

Each evening, while Dad walks down the hill to find signal, someone in heather purple stands out past the firelight with its hands held out to the fire. It's one stone nearer every night.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Would you have sat on the empty seat after dark?
